name: Forza Motorsport 4
notes: Every table of the game's database. max = largest value of the column in the base game and in its official DLC packages (archives); a new row's key is max + 1 or more.
keys = the primary key; without one (keySource firstIdColumn) the first id column; keySource none = the table has no id (nothing to number).
columns = the keys and every other id column (…Id, …ID, Ordinal) that holds an integer. maxIn / byArchive say which archive has the largest.
Packs made by Forza Studio or anyone else are NOT counted here; Forza Studio reads the installed packages at run time (DbIds, DlcWorld).
